notes: The Sunken Verge (region_sunken_verge). templates\shop_template.flp: clarinet_low on flute_wood (Emulator II Clarinet, PITCH -17, insert 2), harp on guitar_nylon (Ample Guitar, insert 6), pluck_drop on reed_concertina (Emulator II Marimba, -12, insert 4), bass_upright on the Diamond bass channels with brinewood's key fixes plus Eb2 from E2 on bass_a2 (insert 3), pad_soft on pad_strings (12 Low Strings +12, insert 5; needs Osc2 off/Osc1 7.32 in FL). v2: bass Ab2 plays G2 on bass_g3 (+108, -5 dB), Eb2 clone at 0 dB, harp Eb2 up an octave (Ample Guitar stops at E2), darker pluck/clarinet cuts, +3 dB at 220 Hz on the bass for small speakers.
